What changed. Current: original print CSS, freshly rendered with its fonts embedded. Blog: PP Neue Montreal, the blog's print type scale, metadata, shaded overview and 32mm side-caption rail; wide tables span the rail. Hybrid: Newsreader 10.75pt / 1.52, IBM Plex section headings, stronger hierarchy, more spacing, captions below figures, and equations kept with their explanations.

The baseline is the Claude branch at 4cd5248; the blog reference is windborne-web at 70a09bc. This is a visual specimen, not newly verified research. The sample's discussion of font measurements describes the original template. Figures are intentionally unchanged, so their small labels remain visible as a separate issue to address after choosing a direction. HTML files contain embedded fonts for this local comparison.
